name: Webflow
description: Connect your own Webflow site(s) via a Site Token to manage them from Imperal -- publish and edit CMS Collection items, manage Pages and static/dynamic content, browse and moderate Form submissions, upload media Assets, read and reply to Comments, manage Ecommerce products/SKUs/orders/inventory, set up Webhooks, and configure 301 redirects. Uses your own Webflow Site Token (or an optional read-only Workspace Token for cross-site rollups) -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself. Note: Custom Code (registering/applying scripts) requires Webflow's own OAuth Data Client App flow and is not available to Site Tokens -- out of scope here; Enterprise-only Workspace Management and Audit Logs are also out of scope.

tools.name: connect_webflow
tools.description: Connect a Webflow site by saving its Site Token (Site Settings > Apps & integrations > API access), after checking it actually works.

tools.name: connect_webflow_workspace
tools.description: Connect a Webflow Workspace by saving its Workspace Token (read-only, all sites in the workspace), after checking it actually works.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Webflow sites/workspaces.

tools.name: disconnect_webflow
tools.description: Disconnect one Webflow site/workspace. Nothing in Webflow itself is changed; the saved token is deleted here.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List Webflow sites reachable from the connected token(s).

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Read one Webflow site in full.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish a Webflow site to its live domain(s) and/or webflow.io staging domain -- pushes any staged CMS/page changes live. Confirm with the user before calling this on a production domain.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages (and page folders) of a Webflow site.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one Webflow page's metadata (title, slug, SEO fields, publish state) -- not its content nodes, use get_page_content for those.

tools.name: update_page_metadata
tools.description: Update a Webflow page's title, slug, SEO title/description, and/or Open Graph image -- does not touch the page's content nodes.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read one Webflow page's DOM nodes (the actual editable page content -- text nodes and component instances), for review or before making a targeted edit.

tools.name: update_page_content
tools.description: Update one or more DOM text nodes on a Webflow page -- e.g. change a heading's or paragraph's text. Pass node ids from get_page_content plus their new text.

tools.name: duplicate_page
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Webflow page under a new title/slug -- a quick way to spin up an A/B variant or a localized copy without rebuilding it from scratch in the Designer.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all CMS Collections on a Webflow site (e.g. Blog Posts, Products, Categories).

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Read one CMS Collection's schema in full -- its fields, types, and which are required/editable. Call before creating or updating an Item so you know the exact field slugs to use.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new CMS Collection on a Webflow site -- a new content type like 'Blog Posts' or 'Team Members'. Use get_collection afterwards to see the default fields Webflow adds, before adding your own via the Designer (field creation beyond the Name/Slug defaults is Designer-only).

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Permanently delete a CMS Collection and every Item inside it. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_collection_items
tools.description: List Items inside a CMS Collection -- e.g. all blog posts or all products, with their field data.

tools.name: get_collection_item
tools.description: Read one CMS Item in full, including all of its field data.

tools.name: create_collection_item
tools.description: Create a new CMS Item (e.g. a new blog post or product) with the given field data. Call get_collection first to see the exact field slugs the Collection expects. Defaults to a draft that will NOT appear on the live site until publish_collection_items is called.

tools.name: update_collection_item
tools.description: Update field data on an existing CMS Item. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: delete_collection_item
tools.description: Permanently delete a CMS Item. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: publish_collection_items
tools.description: Push one or more staged/draft CMS Items live on the published site -- the step that actually makes new or edited content publicly visible.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List images/files in a Webflow site's media library.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read one media library asset's full metadata and hosted URL.

tools.name: upload_asset_from_url
tools.description: Add a publicly reachable https:// image/file to a Webflow site's media library, so it can be referenced from CMS Items or page content (e.g. an AI-generated image from Media Studio).

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Permanently delete a media library asset. Cannot be undone -- any page/CMS content still referencing it will show a broken image.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List native Webflow forms on a site (built with the Designer's Form Block).

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Read one Webflow form's field schema in full.

tools.name: list_form_submissions
tools.description: List submissions received on one Webflow form -- who submitted what, and when.

tools.name: get_form_submission
tools.description: Read one form submission in full.

tools.name: delete_form_submission
tools.description: Permanently delete a form submission (e.g. spam). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Ecommerce products (with their SKUs/variants) on a Webflow site. Only meaningful on sites with Webflow Ecommerce enabled.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one Ecommerce product in full, including its SKUs and prices.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new Ecommerce product with its default SKU. Created in staging by default -- publish the site to make it live.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update an Ecommerce product's name, description and/or visibility.

tools.name: update_sku
tools.description: Update one SKU/variant's price and/or option values (e.g. color, size) on an Ecommerce product.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Permanently delete an Ecommerce product and its SKUs. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Read one SKU's current stock level and inventory type (finite/infinite).

tools.name: update_inventory
tools.description: Set a SKU's stock quantity and/or inventory type (finite vs infinite).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List Ecommerce orders on a Webflow site, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read one Ecommerce order in full -- status, customer, totals, shipping.

tools.name: update_order
tools.description: Set shipping/tracking details on an existing Ecommerce order.

tools.name: fulfill_order
tools.description: Mark an Ecommerce order as fulfilled (shipped), optionally emailing the customer.

tools.name: unfulfill_order
tools.description: Revert an Ecommerce order back to unfulfilled.

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refund an Ecommerce order through Webflow's own payment processor. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks configured on a Webflow site -- which events push notifications to which URL.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Read one webhook's full configuration.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook on a Webflow site: which event triggers it (one of form_submission, site_publish, page_created, page_metadata_updated, page_deleted, ecomm_new_order, ecomm_order_changed, ecomm_inventory_changed, user_account_added, user_account_updated, user_account_deleted, collection_item_created, collection_item_changed, collection_item_deleted, collection_item_unpublished) and which URL receives the POST payload. Use this so Imperal (or any other system) gets notified in real time on form submissions, new orders, CMS changes, or site publishes -- instead of polling.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove a webhook. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_comment_threads
tools.description: List Webflow Editor comment threads left on a site's pages -- feedback/review notes from collaborators.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List reusable Components on a Webflow site (shared page fragments authored in the Designer, e.g. a shared header/footer/card). Read-only -- Components can only be created/edited inside the Webflow Designer itself.

tools.name: get_component_content
tools.description: Read one Component's DOM node tree -- what's actually inside a reusable Component instance.

tools.name: list_redirects
tools.description: List 301 URL redirects configured on a Webflow site (Enterprise plan feature) -- which old URLs redirect to which new ones.

tools.name: create_redirect
tools.description: Create a 301 redirect from an old URL to a new one (Enterprise plan feature) -- essential after a page slug change or migration, so old links/backlinks/search rankings aren't lost.

tools.name: delete_redirect
tools.description: Permanently delete a 301 redirect.

secrets.name: webflow_connections
secrets.description: Your connected Webflow sites -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per site, each with its own Site Token (site_token) plus site_id/site_name. Managed through connect_webflow / disconnect_webflow -- you should not need to edit this directly.

secrets.name: webflow_workspace_token
secrets.description: Optional read-only Workspace Token, giving cross-site access to every site in one Webflow Workspace (best for monitoring/auditing many sites at once, instead of connecting each site individually with its own Site Token). Managed through connect_webflow_workspace / disconnect_webflow_workspace.
